issue.title: ledger-tools note-ready and relation-index startup tests fail since 1295e52: test fakes keep one onLayoutReady slot that setupGcalEvents overwrites
issue.description:
Found by the bob-cli-e6 relaunch land agent (bob-cli-e6.land, 2026-10-30) while running bob-plugins `npm test` to verify recovered e6 plugin work. Not caused by bob-cli-e6.

Two bob-plugins Node tests fail deterministically on bob-plugins origin/master 5ba4683:

- `scripts/test-ledger-tools-note-ready.cjs` › "the startup storm is linear": `one note-ready eligibility scan plus one relation-index prefilter scan` — actual 1, expected 2 (line ~1184).
- `scripts/test-ledger-tools-relation-index.cjs` › "relationIndex registers after layout-ready and never reads non-markdown during startup replay": `relation scan should finish after layout-ready` — false !== true (waitUntil, line ~83/280).

Bisect (each run in a clean detached worktree, the two files only): 957f741, cd214ff, 116ad00 pass; 1295e52 (bob-cli-ea.8, "feat(ledger-tools): sync and paint Calendar events") fails both. Same result with and without the uncommitted e6 landing patch, so e6 is not involved.

Root cause: 1295e52 adds `this.setupGcalEvents()` to BobLedgerToolsPlugin.onload (src/170-plugin-lifecycle.js) after the relation-index / note-ready setup. `setupGcalSyncOnCreate()` (src/291-plugin-gcal-events.js:220-232) registers its own `workspace.onLayoutReady(...)` callback. Both test harnesses model onLayoutReady as a single slot (`handlers.onLayoutReady = callback` in test-ledger-tools-note-ready.cjs:211-212, and the equivalent at test-ledger-tools-relation-index.cjs:98), so the later gcal registration overwrites the relation-index/note-ready callback and the tests invoke only the gcal one. Real Obsidian queues every onLayoutReady callback, so this is most likely a harness gap, not a production regression — confirm by making the fakes queue callbacks (call all in order) and re-running; if anything still fails, check whether the gcal layout-ready work reorders the startup scans.

The bob-cli-ea land note (#3/#4) reported 29 focused tests passing but did not run these two suites.

The failure is a deterministic count/ordering assertion (1 !== 2 scans), traced to the single-slot onLayoutReady fake being overwritten by the new gcal onLayoutReady registration.

issue.creation_reason: bob-plugins npm test has two deterministic failures introduced by bob-cli-ea.8 1295e52 that the ea landing did not catch; found while verifying the bob-cli-e6 relaunch landing.

payload.description: bob-cli-ea.8 commit 1295e52 introduced the second onLayoutReady registration that breaks these harnesses

evidence.note: Independent repro by bob-cli-e8.land on bob-plugins master 8dbcbea (plus an unrelated one-line nav Task Card fix): full npm test 4384/4382 with exactly these two failures; each file fails 3/3 when run alone. Bisect with git-archive trees over 90dbc6a..81a75b8: every commit through 116ad00 passes both, 1295e52 (bob-cli-ea.8) is first to fail both. Confirmed both fakes store onLayoutReady in a single slot (relation-index.cjs:98-99 layoutReadyCallback, note-ready.cjs:211-212 handlers.onLayoutReady). Impact: bob-plugins npm test stays red, masking regressions in the relation index that bob-cli-e8 extended.
